title: The Storm
text: A storm comes out of nowhere, the sky going black in a breath. Purple lightning walks across the land on long legs, striding and stooping, and the ground smokes where its feet come down. It is coming this way.

options.label: Find shelter and wait, without looking out at what walks.

outcomes.text: You wait a long, cold while in a cave as the lightning steps past outside.

options.label: The quickest leads the race to the next ridge before the lightning reaches you.

outcomes.text: You make it, and the storm loses you.
The lightning stoops and catches someone.

options.label: The cleverest catches some lightning in a bottle; it may be worth the risk.

outcomes.text: The bottle holds, though the hand does not.
